about: A person's colour (docs/dev/collab.md 'What the user sees'): the index of one of the eight --peer-N colours (frontend app.css, gamma/pdf_cards.py PEOPLE), from their name: hash = hash * 31 + code point, kept to 32 bits, over the name's code points, modulo 8. gamma/pdf_cards.py person_color and frontend/src/collaboration/personColor.js. Read by backend/tests/test_shared_fixtures.py and frontend/tests/personColor.test.mjs.

names.note: a missing name is no name
an astral character is one code point
